parameters.name: tcroot
parameters.meaning: root thickness ratio; per-station thickness ~ tcroot * rtcs[station]

geometry_construction: half-span is AR*(1+TR)/4 with root chord 1; thickness factors compound multiplicatively, twists compound additively, both cubic splines on the mesher station grid
bounds_rule: unit coordinates in [0,1] correspond to physical mean +/- 3.5 population sd; submission is validated against the benchmark domain

fields.job_id: identifier of the run that produced it
fields.task_id: task identity the request was bound to
fields.geometry_sha256: canonical hash of the exact 38 coordinates evaluated
fields.outcome_kind: pass when the profile completed; undetermined when it did not
fields.delivery: true when an aggregate score exists

aggregate.score_eligible: an aggregate exists only for a complete profile
aggregate.cfd_ld_geomean: geometric mean of L/D over the valid conditions, or null

fields.conditions: one row per flight condition: index, mach, cl_target, state, aoa_deg, cl, cd, ld, cl_error, trim_valid, n_step, final_residual_rho. A condition that did not converge reports its state and step count with null force coefficients.
fields.reason_codes: short machine-readable reasons for the outcome

artifacts.residual_history.csv: condition,mach,iteration,res_rho,res_mom,res_energy,cl,cd - the residual and force history actually produced for each condition

evaluation_record.note: the result file is written only after its artifacts are in place, so if observations/<request_id>.json exists its files are complete
